Attached: 1 image

an AI just did brain surgery on another AI lol

mit researchers gave gpt-6 astra the raw weights of a tiny qwen model and said: make it better at math. no training allowed.

it found what made the model loop forever and edited 131,072 weights. that's 0.016% of the model.

math-500 went from 7.9% to 48.1%.

the catch: same trick did nothing on a model that didn't loop. it removed a blocker, it didn't add a skill.
